modmenu.summaryTranslation.mbs: A vanilla style structure mod adding ~150 structures built for the Biomes O' Plenty mod
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mbs: Moog's Bountiful Structures adds around 150 custom built structures designed to feel right at home across BOP's incredible variety of biomes. Whether you're wandering through a lavender field or traversing the dead forest, there's always something new waiting around the corner.
